requirements.requirement: The system must include unit tests that validate scoring output for NIH (agency_class=NIH) returns a credibility_score within the expected high range (e.g., >= configured threshold).
The system must include unit tests that validate scoring output for Industry sponsors returns a credibility_score consistent with defined mapping rules.
The system must include unit tests that validate scoring output for Academic or inferred academic sponsors returns a credibility_score consistent with mapping logic.
The system must include unit tests that validate scoring output for Other/unknown sponsor types returns a lower or fallback credibility_score.
The system must include a unit test verifying that missing lead_sponsor data triggers fallback scoring logic without runtime failure.
The system must include a unit test verifying that multiple collaborators influence the final credibility_score according to defined collaborator weighting rules.
The system must include a unit test verifying deterministic output (same input sponsor data always produces identical credibility_score).
The system must include a unit test verifying that credibility_score is always normalized between 0 and 1 inclusive.
The system must include a unit test verifying that an explanation field is generated and non-empty for all valid scoring outputs.
The system must include an integration test that validates the Evaluate Care API response contains sponsor_credibility fields when sponsor data is present.
The system must include an integration test that validates sponsor_credibility fields include sponsor_type, credibility_score, and explanation in the API response schema.
The system must include an integration test verifying that absence of sponsor data does not break the API response and returns either null or fallback sponsor_credibility.
The system must include a unit test verifying that invalid or unexpected agency_class values are handled gracefully and mapped to fallback scoring without exception.
The system must include a unit test verifying that collaborator-only scenarios (no lead_sponsor but collaborators present) still produce a valid credibility_score.
